svg.title: Blue Green Black Red
svg.desc: Interpretive study from a visually inspected primary gallery photograph. Approximate geometry and interpretive palette. Photograph perspective, shadows and texture omitted. Palette refinement (2026-11-09): specific source-image review of red, green, black, blue; interpretive screen colors, not calibrated to original paint.
svg.metadata: Primary reference: https://matthewmarks.com/exhibitions/ellsworth-kelly-diagonal-02-2009/lightbox/works/blue-green-black-red-2007-31220; inspected 2026-10-27. This editable vector is a study, not a facsimile.
